step.label: Initiate engineering change request
step.description: Engineering teams submit product design changes that require cross-functional impact assessment and resource allocation.
step.useCase: Manufacturing organization receives customer feedback on product design and initiates formal engineering change process

step.label: Validate material and product impact
step.description: Assess how proposed engineering changes affect bill of materials, product configurations, and inventory requirements.
step.useCase: Supply chain team confirms material availability and vendor lead times for changed product specifications

step.label: Analyze change business impact
step.description: Generate operational insights and impact projections across product portfolio to inform stakeholder decision-making.
step.useCase: Sales and product management review revenue, margin, and customer impact analysis before proceeding with engineering change

step.label: Update product item specifications
step.description: Formalize engineering change documentation by updating product item master data and change control records.
step.useCase: Product engineering team records approved changes in centralized product lifecycle management system

step.label: Evaluate workforce compensation impact
step.description: Determine if engineering changes trigger skill requirement shifts, incentive plan adjustments, or workforce redeployment needs.
step.useCase: HR and finance teams evaluate whether product changes require compensation adjustments for engineering or manufacturing staff

step.label: Orchestrate talent acquisition campaign
step.description: Launch targeted recruitment campaigns to source specialized skills required by the product change initiative.
step.useCase: Talent acquisition team launches campaign targeting engineers and technicians with skills needed for new product manufacturing processes

step.label: Manage campaign access and targeting
step.description: Configure campaign permissions, audience segmentation, and communication channels for recruitment campaign execution.
step.useCase: Marketing operations team grants HR recruiting team access to campaign management platform with appropriate customer account segmentation

step.label: Monitor service delivery impact
step.description: Track operational performance metrics, service ticket trends, and IT equipment utilization against change implementation timeline.
step.useCase: IT operations and customer service teams monitor whether engineering changes impact system availability, support ticket volume, or infrastructure requirements
